title: User Configuration
description: A person or a service user who assumes project roles. Roles are granted per project and environment; a person's login must exist in Snowflake unless create is true, a service user is always created by Terraform, with its key.

login.description: Snowflake login name (exact, as CURRENT_USER() returns it)

type.description: person (default) logs in interactively; service is a TYPE = SERVICE user for a deployment (dlt with the ingest role, dbt with the transform role), created by Terraform with rsa_public_key

rsa_public_key.description: Service users only: the public key body `just sf keygen <login>` prints (one line, no BEGIN/END header); the private key stays in ~/.snowflake/keys/<login>.p8

email.description: Email, only used when creating the user

schema_prefix.description: Prefix of the personal schemas (<PREFIX>_SRC, ...) and SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA in .env; defaults to DBT_<login before the @, non-alphanumerics as _, upper case>

not.description: DBT is the placeholder an empty SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA falls back to; it must never have schemas

create.description: Persons only: create the user in Snowflake with a one-time password; false when the login already exists (SSO)

roles.description: Project roles this user may assume

environments.description: Environment keys, or '*' for every environment of the project

login.description: Upper case, so the quoted name Terraform creates and the unquoted one a connection uses are the same user
